content:
Looking at each shape as a union of two congruent squares:

- **B:** Two congruent squares centered at the same point, one rotated 45° → eight-pointed star. ✔
- **C:** One square plus a 45°-rotated square centered on the midpoint of its bottom edge → downward arrow. ✔
- **D:** Two squares offset diagonally (overlapping in a smaller square) → staircase shape. ✔
- **E:** Two squares overlapping side-by-side → rectangle. ✔
- **A:** The "house" pentagon would need a 45°-rotated square whose top corner forms the roof. But a congruent rotated square has a half-diagonal of ≈0.71 side lengths, so its side corners would stick out beyond the walls (creating extra vertices), while a rotated square small enough to hide its side corners wouldn't be the same size. Hence the house shape is impossible. ✘

\boxed{A}
